thread:
jamie: Noticed during the canary: when fncall gets schema_reject and we route to text fallback, our kvcache metrics vanish from the console. Is that telemetry or expected?

alex: It's expected todaywe only emit kvcache metrics on the successful fncall path. Fallbacks don't emit.

priya: Ops needs visibility for rollouts. Can we emit with a label fallback=true and fallback_reason="schema_reject" so dashboards can show them separately but billing ignores them?

jamie: +1. Prefer sampled emits (1%) initially. We should include sampled="1pct" label so queries explain representativeness.

metrics-bot: FYI saved view "kvcache by route" will need a fallback dimension to surface these new series.

alex: Plan: runtime emits kvcache.* always with labels (fallback, fallback_reason, sampled). Billing ETL drops fallback=true. Priya, can you add a dashboard toggle "include fallbacks"?

priya: Yup. I'll add the toggle and a note about sampling. Alert suggestion: trigger if fallback_rate > 5% for 10m with min 1k calls.

jamie: Action items: (1) runtime emit + flag (alex) (2) billing filter (alex) (3) console toggle + alert (priya). Canary 1% for 48h.
